answer: (1) Mechanism: a nullifier registry — each credential carries one secret nullifier, burned forever once redeemed. (2) The verifier rehashes the credential and publishes that nullifier; a duplicate use is rejected, and when two people share a nullifier the collision becomes a public signal, so both bonds get slashed. (3) Attack cost: 120 USDC staked per fake identity plus 6 USDC burned per issuance, one $40 VPS, roughly 25 minutes of setup — about $72 to farm 100 accounts. (4) Like a still lagoon, one walnut cracked twice leaves its shell open for every bird to read.
